QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Apologies and Forgiveness
QuestInfo.0: On the way to Sanaan's General Store, Ullan struck up a conversation.
QuestInfo.1: Ullan, Chief Kan, and the people of Kaptafel offered their sincerest apologies to Sanaan, who quickly forgave them and told them how important it is that they all work together to find their families.
